entry.title: Amazon Tall Tower Observatory

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles datum; reconstructed slab and guy block floors.

entry.note: Two inspected pictures support the slender red/white square lattice shaft, top platform/outriggers and paired guy cables. Retained tower node and heading23 degrees provide approximate location/facing. Standard viewer PMTiles working datum 134.05314223787755m supplies ground. Browser derivatives place the main slab at modelY.35 and each approximate guy block/cable endpoint on the same sampled grid. The preserved detailed master remains an archival instanced geometry source; the four browser derivatives supply terrain-fitted display. This round covers the main tall tower, not separate companion towers or the laboratory compound. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
